analysis: The trial crashed with subprocess exit status 1 after 1.77 allocated GPU-seconds. The supplied traceback contains only the worker’s CalledProcessError; it does not reveal the underlying training exception or establish which stage failed. No validation score or predictive success was reported. The script attempts to save uncaught exceptions to working/training_error.log, but that log was not provided. The added diagnostics are not a verified execution fix.
code_summary: Per-category sparse linear recommendation using binary training histories. Each target item selects up to 128 neighbors by cosine co-occurrence similarity, then fits local ridge regressions with penalties 10, 100, and 1000 using an eigendecomposition. Validation HR@10, with NDCG@10 as a tie-breaker, selects weights independently for all four categories. Inference sums learned coefficients over unique history items. The predictor writer embeds the same inference class and loads category-specific sparse weights. Training preserves the provided splits and uses GAGC_DATA_DIR; artifacts are written beneath working.
